name: GA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Hank Johnson running for reelection
Polymarket prices Johnson at 97% to win
Republican challenger James Duffie shows minimal fundraising
model.rationale: The D+27 fundamentals, Johnson's incumbency, and his renomination make this a heavily Democratic seat, and prediction markets price his win probability at 97%. With no competitive polling or expert ratings suggesting otherwise, the race stays at its baseline margin.
model.watch: Any late-breaking outside spending or a polling surprise showing Johnson under 60% would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Georgia's 4th District is a solidly Democratic Atlanta-area seat, with a partisan lean of D+27. Incumbent Hank Johnson, first elected in 2006, has been renominated and seeks another term. His Republican opponent, James Duffie, has reported little in the way of fundraising, while Johnson has raised roughly $400,000 and holds a cash advantage.

No public general-election polls or expert race ratings are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and money. Prediction markets give Johnson about a 97% chance of winning. The forecast places this race firmly in the Safe Democratic column, with Johnson expected to win by a wide, roughly 28-point margin.
